Date: 2026-08-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up from today's discovery — MAP and timeline

Aditya,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Helpful to see Redwood's runtime approach and the cost/latency tradeoffs you mentioned. A couple of follow-ups from our side as we get procurement moving: 

- Can you send a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out milestones, owners, and a target close date? Our legal and procurement teams want clarity on dependencies (SOC2 evidence, deployment model options, and data residency).
- On pricing: our procurement lead asked whether you have flexibility on credits or an initial discount tied to a commit level. Our preferred close window is end of September (roughly 2026-09-30).

If you can get a MAP to us by end of day tomorrow, that would help. I'll share internally once it's in.

Best,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of AI Platforms | FinexCorp
[ph: +1 415 555 0123]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-21T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's discovery — MAP and timeline

Hi Liam —

Appreciate the quick recap. Attaching a first-pass MAP (see attachment). Highlights:

Proposed target close date: 2026-09-30 (aligned with your procurement window).
Key milestones (high-level):
- Week 1–2: Pilot kickoff (data access, integration POC) — Owner: FinexCorp eng (primary), Redwood SE (support)
- Week 3–6: Validation & performance tuning (latency/cost targets, KV caching) — Owners: joint
- Week 7–10: Security/compliance review (SOC2 evidence, network design) — Owner: FinexCorp procurement/legal (we'll provide artifacts)
- Week 11–12: Contract & procurement sign-off + production cutover plan — Owners: FinexCorp procurement, Redwood sales/legal

Dependencies called out in the MAP: SOC2 report, preferred region for private deployment (if required), and any specific DPA terms.

Pricing/credits: preliminary guidance is attached in the MAP as a committed-tier proposal (12-month commit). I understand you asked about credits/discounts — to get approval for any deviation from list/committed pricing I need an exec-level review. If you are looking for an upfront credit (or tiered discounts tied to commit level), please confirm the commit size you expect (a $120k ARR commit or similar helps expedite evaluation).

Attachment: [mutual_action_plan_finex_v1.xlsx (Excel, 54KB)]

I'll follow up internally to get pricing approval routed to our Revenue Ops and EVPs; Monica is on the thread and will help with program details. Happy to hop on a short call tomorrow if that helps.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 650 555 0199

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finexcorp.com>, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-22T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft — procurement dependencies & pricing ask

Hi Liam / Aditya —

Thanks for the MAP draft, Aditya — good structure. A couple of clarifications from procurement/legal perspective so we can scope the pricing ask properly: 

- SOC2: we will provide our latest SOC2 Type II and the list of logs requested (audit log retention window is a dependency).
- Deployment model: FinexCorp indicated they may want a VPC/private option in prod. That influences SLA and support credits.
- Commit ask (FinexCorp): procurement is looking at a 12-month commit with a $120k spend target. As part of that, they want a one-time onboarding credit to offset initial integration effort.

Pricing request for exec review (concrete):
- Commit: $120,000 over 12 months
- Requested concession: 12% upfront credit to be applied to first 3 months, conditional on signed SOW/commit
- Contingency: legal redlines limited to standard DPA/SLAs (no custom IP clauses)

Aditya — can you escalate this to Revenue Ops / exec pricing and request an approval for the 12% credit? I've attached a redlines summary from procurement.

Attachment: [finex_pricing_redlines.pdf (PDF, 86KB)]

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finexcorp.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-22T17:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft — procurement dependencies & pricing ask (internal note and ack)

Aditya / Monica —

Acknowledged. Liam — thanks for the transparency on timeline and the commit target. Internal notes for the team:

- We can provisionally approve a commercial concession, but the level needs calibration against support overhead for a VPC/private deployment and SOC2 deliverables.
- Proposed counter: 10% onboarding credit (applied to first invoice cycle) for a $120k 12-month commit, with an escalation path to 12% if FinexCorp agrees to a 24-month commit or expands to an enterprise dedicated pool within 9 months.
- Legal: keep DPA/SLAs standard; any deviations will void the onboarding credit unless approved by Legal Counsel.

Aditya — please open a formal pricing approval request in Sales Ops (include the MAP and procurement redlines), and route to VP Revenue (cc: me). Monica, keep me posted on any additional dependencies (e.g., IP clause asks).

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com

3) Action items for FinexCorp to keep the timeline: please confirm the preferred production region and whether you require private/VPC deployment (this affects SLA and Delivery lead time).

Proposed next meeting: 2026-08-26 @ 10:00 PT — 30 minutes to finalize MAP owners and sign-off criteria. Does that work on your end?
